'''Vaner''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Vaner was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] as a weapons vendor.
